pages.title: Cocoon Crossing
pages.creator: cong game
pages.description:
Cocoon Crossing is a routing puzzle about guiding caterpillars to cocoons of the same color. Drag either end of a caterpillar to move it through the board one tile at a time. Reaching the matching cocoon transforms it into a butterfly, and every caterpillar needs to get home to complete the puzzle.

The routes must fit together without two worms overlapping at the same height. Crossing tiles let one travel over a bridge while another passes through a tunnel underneath. Plan those crossings within the level's move allowance and try to meet par for a star. Undo lets you reconsider a move, while hints offer help with a difficult arrangement.

pages.title: Obby Toilet Line
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Obby Toilet Line turns a gas-station restroom queue into an idle progression game. Earn money while waiting, move closer to the front, and work toward reaching the toilet at the end. Your place in the queue determines your earnings, so advancing also changes how quickly you can make money.

Move with WASD, press E to interact, and use Space for jumping or skipping forward in the line. The task connects moving around the crowded station with gradually improving your position in its long restroom queue.

pages.title: Anime Dress Up - Doll Dress Up
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description:
Anime Dress Up - Doll Dress Up gives you an anime-style figure to customize through clothing, hair, and accessories. Choose pieces from the wardrobe and apply them to the doll, combining the selections into a complete outfit.

Use touch-and-drag controls to try different hairstyles, garments, and finishing accessories. Once the character has the look you want, you can save the result. The focus stays on creating your own fashion combination and experimenting with how the wardrobe pieces work together.

pages.title: Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description:
Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle combines clearing a crowded parking area with matching passengers to vehicles of the same color. Slide cars and buses to open routes, then guide the passengers toward the appropriate vehicles. A blocked path makes the order of your moves important.

Work through each layout with as few moves as possible to aim for its best star result. Different arrangements of cars, buses, and waiting passengers change the puzzle, asking you to make room while keeping the color matches in mind.

pages.title: Little Hero Knight
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Little Hero Knight combines fighting monsters with constructing a base that can defend itself. Travel through the world with your weapon, collect coins, and spend them on structures such as walls, barracks, houses, and defense towers. The battlefield develops as you add more of those buildings.

Unlock additional weapons and tower options to change the setup you use against the monsters. Your role covers both the hero's direct fighting and decisions about what to build, with collected coins linking the battles to stronger defenses. Click or tap to interact with the game as you expand and customize your base.

pages.title: Waterpark Sort
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description:
Waterpark Sort is a sorting puzzle about arranging colored riders in canoes. Tap people to move them between seats and work toward grouping the passengers by color. Completing a canoe lets it leave, bringing the queue closer to being cleared.

The boats and their available seats make each move matter. Consider which person to move first and leave room for the passengers still waiting to be sorted. Keep an eye on the move counter as you organize the canoes and work through the level.

pages.title: Merge Brainrot 2
pages.creator: Colormind Games
pages.description:
Merge Brainrot 2 is a dropping-and-merging puzzle built around Italian Brainrot characters. Drag a meme into position at the top of the screen and release it into the play area. When two identical characters touch, they combine into a different one.

The collection includes characters such as Bobrito Bandito and Burbaloni Lulilolli. Position each drop to bring matching memes together, then keep combining the new results to discover later characters in the chain. The overall goal is to reach the final Brainrot transformation.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash puts a geometric wave on a route through obstacles. Hold the left mouse button or up arrow to make it ascend, then release to descend. Switching between those two movements lets you guide the wave through the gaps ahead.

Different levels feature Italian Brainrot characters, including Tralalero Tralala and Tung Tung Tung Sahur. Watch the changing obstacle pattern and time each hold and release to stay on a clear route through the course.

pages.title: Valentine's Day Couple Date
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description:
Valentine's Day Couple Date follows Ellie and Ben through a day together in Paris. Start with a breakfast look for Ellie, then choose gym clothes and accessories for the couple's workout. Their final outing is a rooftop dinner that calls for another change of style.

Use the mouse or touch controls to select clothing, accessories, and hairstyles for each occasion. The different activities give you several looks to create across the same day, moving from breakfast preparations to sportswear and then a romantic dinner outfit.

pages.title: Crazy Bus Station
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Crazy Bus Station asks you to clear vehicles from a parking area while matching them with waiting passengers. Click a vehicle to send it in the direction of its arrow, making sure nothing blocks the route before it moves. Getting the right passengers into their cars is part of clearing the lot.

Examine the arrows and available space before choosing the next vehicle. Sorting and shuffle boosters can help when the arrangement becomes difficult, giving you another way to reorganize the puzzle and open a useful path.

pages.title: Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description:
Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG puts an armed rabbit at the center of a survival shooting adventure. Develop your hero while taking on monsters across different maps, using weapons and equipment to build a setup for the challenges ahead.

You can unlock additional rabbits with their own attributes, then choose between them as you progress. Weapons and props can be combined in different arrangements, so character choice and equipment both contribute to your approach. Upgrading the rabbit and experimenting with those combinations are part of preparing for different monsters and difficulty levels.

pages.title: Hoop World 3D
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description:
Hoop World 3D combines aerial flips with basketball dunks. Judge the movement so your flip carries you to the hoop, then finish the approach with a dunk. Poor timing can leave you short of the net and falling before the shot is complete.

Use the game's one-finger mouse or keypad interaction to control the movement. The challenge is judging the airborne sequence well enough to reach the basket, balancing the flip with the distance still needed for the dunk.

pages.title: Mine 2D Survival Herobrine
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description:
Mine 2D Survival Herobrine is a block-building survival game set in an open world with Noob. Break blocks to gather resources, improve your supplies and use them to construct your own structures. Exploring and building take place alongside the threat of hostile monsters, while Herobrine adds frightening encounters to the world.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. The left mouse button destroys blocks, the right mouse button places them, and E opens the inventory or store. Gathering materials gives you more options for construction, but you also need to respond to the creatures around you as you work.

pages.title: Home Design: Small House
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description:
Home Design: Small House is a room-organizing game about putting household objects in suitable places. Sort through the items in each room and arrange them so the space becomes orderly. The task focuses on where the objects belong within the room's layout.

Drag an item and drop it into the position you think fits. Work through the objects one at a time, using the available locations to turn the untidy arrangement into a neatly organized room.

pages.title: Base Jump Wingsuit Flying
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description:
Base Jump Wingsuit Flying is an arcade flying game about launching into the air and guiding a wingsuit flight. Use the mouse to start a jump, then control the flight as you travel across the environment. Your goal is to improve the score reached on each attempt.

Different settings provide new places to fly through. Judge your movement after the launch and keep working on the route you take, using each jump as another opportunity to beat your previous high score.

pages.title: Super Hero Driving School
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description:
Super Hero Driving School puts unusual superhero-themed vehicles onto stunt tracks. Drive along the courses, take to the air with the vehicles' flying action, and work through the stunts each track presents. Crashes are part of the challenge when a maneuver goes wrong.

Use the mouse to control play and tackle the routes with the different vehicles available. The game combines driving and flight, asking you to handle the approach to a stunt as well as what happens once the vehicle leaves the ground.

pages.title: Word Ocean
pages.creator: Uni7 Team
pages.description:
Word Ocean asks you to fill rows of empty squares by making words from a circle of letters. Connect the letters in the order needed to spell a word, then use the length of the remaining spaces to work out the other answers. Every missing word must be found to clear the level.

The letter circle grows as you progress, giving you more characters to combine. Look at the available letters and the unfinished word lengths together, trying different arrangements until all the rows above the circle are complete.

pages.title: Delivery by tractor
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Delivery by tractor makes you responsible for collecting fruit and taking it to a customer. Drive up to a fruit tree and shake it so the produce falls into your trailer, then transport the load to its destination. Larger deliveries earn more coins, with an additional bonus for completing an order.

Use the arrow controls or A and D to drive backward and forward. W shakes a tree, while S or Space applies the handbrake. Spend the delivery earnings on tractor improvements or another tractor or trailer, expanding the equipment you use for later orders.

pages.title: Hair Challenge Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Hair Challenge Rush turns a running course into a contest to finish with long hair. Slide to move along the route and collect hair as you go, building the length that will be measured with a ruler. The final comparison makes collecting part of the race objective.

Choose your route through the course and use shortcuts where they help your progress. Keep looking for another hair pickup as you run, trying to reach the end with a longer hairstyle for the measurement.

pages.title: Pet Party
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description:
Pet Party is a physics-based brawler with puppies, kittens, and other furry fighters. Battle friends in the available modes, using the animals' movement and physical interactions to take part in the fight. The playful character designs sit around a game built on grabbing and hitting opponents.

Move with WASD and use the left and right mouse buttons for holding and striking. Keep positioning your animal during the confrontation so you can reach another fighter and respond to their attacks.

pages.title: Catch That Cat
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Catch That Cat challenges you to recognize one particular cat among many similar pictures. Check the target shown in the panel on the left, then search the board for the exact matching image. Select the cat you have identified to complete that part of the puzzle.

Use the mouse or touch screen to make your choices. Compare the target's small details with the cats in the board, working through the requested matches until the search is complete.

pages.title: Ultimate OffRoad Cars 2
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description:
Ultimate OffRoad Cars 2 gives you a truck and a series of off-road obstacle courses to negotiate. Control its speed and direction through the difficult sections, using the vehicle's cable when you need help pulling it through a problem spot.

Drive with the arrow keys and use Space to brake. X releases the cable, while C pulls the car with it. Combine careful driving with the recovery equipment as you work out how to get the truck through each course.

pages.title: Hide Or Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Hide Or Seek puts the two sides of a hiding game into a small maze. As the seeker, examine footprints and dust for signs of where the other characters have gone. Those clues help you track someone who is out of direct sight.

As a hider, keep away from the seeker's field of view and choose a route that helps you remain undiscovered until time runs out. Use the mouse or touch controls to play, changing your decisions according to whether you are following a trail or trying to avoid leaving yourself exposed.

pages.title: Stick Figure Badminton 3
pages.creator: Effing Games Inc.
pages.description:
Stick Figure Badminton 3 puts you into a badminton tournament against increasingly difficult opponents. Move your stick-figure player into position, jump when needed, and swing to keep the shuttle in play. The first player to reach seven points wins the match.

Use WASD or the arrow keys for movement, with Up to jump and Down to swing. Winning lets you advance through the competition, where stronger opponents demand better positioning and timing from your returns.

pages.title: Ringfencing
pages.creator: Johansson Productions
pages.description:
Ringfencing is a timing game where you launch a dot through rotating rings toward a target. Watch how the rings line up, then click or press Space to send the dot on its way. Successful targets lead into a more demanding sequence as you try to raise your score.

Perks provide help with a run, while modifiers and unlockable modes offer additional challenges. You can also change the colors, background gradients, and animated themes, keeping the same precise-launch mechanic within a different visual style.

pages.title: Fruit Doctor
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description:
Fruit Doctor turns fruit and vegetables into patients in a cartoon clinic. Help a banana that needs stitches, an apple with an injury, or an eggplant having a baby. Each food character brings a different care task for you to carry out.

Work through the game's guided treatment interactions to address the patient's problem. The variety comes from the different fruits, vegetables, and procedures, giving the food-doctor theme a new situation with each case.

pages.title: Mineworld Horror
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Mineworld Horror places a block-style character inside a mansion inhabited by monsters. Explore its many rooms and look for a way out while avoiding the creatures trying to catch you. Escaping the building safely is the main objective.

Watch the route through the mansion as you search, keeping track of where you can move when a monster approaches. The rooms provide both the setting for the escape and the spaces you must get through while dealing with the creatures hunting inside.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Walfs
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Easy Kids Coloring Walfs offers six cartoon-animal drawings to color. Choose a picture, select the colors you want, and paint the character in your own style. Use the mouse or touch controls to work on the selected image.

Once the picture is finished, the print option lets you save a copy of the colored result. You can then choose another drawing from the collection and try a different combination of colors on its outlines.

pages.title: TRZ Cannon
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description:
TRZ Cannon turns each shot into a problem of distance, direction, and power. Aim the cannon so its ball lands inside the basket, adjusting the throw to suit the position of the target. A successful basket is what completes the shot's objective.

Touch the screen and drag to set up the aim, then release to fire. The game contains more than one hundred levels with small puzzle arrangements, giving you new distances and layouts to judge as you work through the cannon challenges.

pages.title: Speed Cars Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Speed Cars Hidden Stars hides ten stars inside each picture of cars. Look through the scene and click or tap the stars you spot, working toward the full set before the timer expires. The six levels provide different pictures to search.

Watch the clock in the lower-right corner as you inspect the image. Small outlines can blend into the car or background, so compare details across the scene and keep track of the areas you still need to check.

pages.title: Color and Decorate Dinner Plate
pages.creator: IG
pages.description:
Color and Decorate Dinner Plate combines coloring with food-themed decoration. Choose from four drawings related to cooking and preparing meals, then add your own colors to the picture. Fruit and vegetable stickers provide another way to decorate the finished artwork.

Use the mouse to work with the coloring and sticker choices. Mix the colors with the food decorations to create your own version of the selected drawing, then explore another page from the collection.

pages.title: Race Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Race Cars Jigsaw gives you twelve racing-car picture puzzles to complete in sequence. Choose a difficulty for the current image: easy divides it into twenty-five pieces, medium into forty-nine, and hard into one hundred. Completing a picture opens the way to the next level.

Drag the pieces into their correct positions to rebuild the car scene. There is no countdown, so you can study the edges and details before placing another piece. Work through all twelve levels at the piece count you want to tackle.

pages.title: Run Royale 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Run Royale 3D sends you into a race where the route is blocked by doors, and only some of them will open. Guide the runner toward a door that can be pushed through and keep moving toward the finish. A wrong choice can interrupt your progress while other racers continue.

Slide to control your runner and change the approach to the next row of doors. Getting through the correct openings is part of the race as you try to reach the finish in first place.

pages.title: Offroad Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Offroad Cars Jigsaw offers twelve images of off-road vehicles to rebuild. Select a picture and choose how many pieces you want to work with: twenty-five for easy, forty-nine for medium, or one hundred for hard. The image is then divided according to that choice.

Fit the pieces into the correct positions to recreate the vehicle picture. You have unlimited playing time, leaving room to compare shapes and image details while working through the collection at your chosen difficulty.

pages.title: Moto Maniac 3
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description:
Moto Maniac 3 takes motorcycle trials into a forest and adds a pursuing bear. Ride over trees, rocks, and the other obstacles while trying to complete the course quickly enough to avoid being caught. The chase adds urgency to keeping the bike balanced through the trial sections.

Use Up or W to drive forward and Down or S to reverse. Left and Right, or A and D, tilt the motorcycle, helping you manage its balance on an obstacle. Keep that control while moving through the forest, and press P when you need to pause.

pages.title: Ancient 2048
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Ancient 2048 gives the number-merging puzzle an ancient-themed setting. Slide the board with a swipe or the arrow keys and bring tiles with equal numbers together. Matching tiles combine into a larger value, with 2048 as the number to work toward.

A move affects the arrangement of the whole board, so consider where the other tiles will end up as well as the pair you want to join. Keep making room for future combinations while building larger numbers.

pages.title: Falling Bricks
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Falling Bricks is a survival challenge where you move a black block along the bottom of the playfield. Barriers descend from above at different speeds, leaving gaps that your block needs to pass through. Move left and right to line up with an opening before the falling pieces reach you.

The score grows the longer you survive. Watch more than just the nearest barrier so your current move also leaves room to reach the next gap, keeping the block away from the descending bricks.

pages.title: Supra Crash Shooting Fly Cars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Supra Crash Shooting Fly Cars combines vehicle combat with driving and flight. Destroy rival cars to earn money, then improve your weapon or buy another car, wheel set, or color. Multiplayer free-for-all fighting and a solo mode against AI vehicles provide different ways to take part.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, R for flight, Space for the handbrake, and F for nitro. Driving and flying change how you approach another vehicle, while the money earned from destruction develops the car and weapons you use in later fights.

pages.title: Pill Volley Beach
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description:
Pill Volley Beach takes volleyball to a tropical-island court with pill-shaped characters. Play on your own or face a friend, moving your character to keep the ball in play and earn more points than the opponent.

Use the arrow controls, WAD keys, or touch input to direct your player. Stay ready to adjust your position for the next return, combining movement and jumping as the rally changes from one side of the net to the other.

pages.title: Baby Daisy Caring and Fun Time
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description:
Baby Daisy Caring and Fun Time is a jigsaw game featuring six pictures of Daisy's activities. Pick a picture, choose an easy, medium or hard mode, and drag the scattered pieces into place to rebuild the scene.

Look for matching edges and parts of the same picture as you arrange the pieces. The three difficulty choices let you change the puzzle challenge, while the selection of scenes gives you another image to assemble when one is complete.

pages.title: Cannelloni
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Cannelloni is a guided cooking game about preparing a pasta dish for a family lunch. Follow the recipe prompts and complete the kitchen tasks in the order shown. Work through the preparation until the cannelloni is ready to serve, using the game's instructions to guide each stage of the meal.

pages.title: Grand Prix Hero
pages.creator: b10b
pages.description:
Grand Prix Hero takes you through a four-race driving series where traffic, boosts and coins share the road. Steer around other vehicles while looking for opportunities to accelerate and collect money. Getting through a crowded stretch without losing your line matters just as much as finding the next boost.

Between races, use the coins you have gathered to improve your car for the next event. The series moves across different continents, giving each race a place in the larger competition. Your goal is to turn those upgrades and cleaner driving into wins throughout the Grand Prix.

pages.title: Casual Box 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Casual Box 2020 is a jumping game built around a cube and a sequence of blocks at different heights. Choose between a small jump and a large jump to carry the cube onward, judging the spacing before you commit to the next leap. Press W for the smaller jump or E for the larger one.

The two jump sizes give you different ways to cross the gaps, so matching the leap to the next block is the central challenge. Keep the cube from falling and try to extend your run.

pages.title: Spacy Hunter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Pilot a spaceship through enemy-filled maps in Spacy Hunter. Move around the play area, fire at hostile ships and avoid their attacks until you have destroyed every enemy in the current level. You control both movement and shooting, so keeping a clear route away from incoming fire is part of each encounter.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and shoot with Space or the left mouse button. Collect coins as you progress, then spend them on additional spaceships or upgrades that strengthen your ship. Clearing the map moves the action onward while those improvements help you prepare for more enemies.

pages.title: Poke Ball
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description:
Poke Ball challenges you to flick a ball upward and see how high you can send it. Use the left mouse button, pressing and releasing to control your attempts. The focus is on the ball's upward progress and the timing of each action.

Keep watching its position as you prepare the next flick. A carefully judged release is the basis of the climb, with height providing a straightforward measure of how far you have managed to go.

pages.title: Real Driving City Car Simulator
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description:
Real Driving City Car Simulator gives you a destination to reach while driving through city streets. Guide the car toward the target position and avoid crashes along the way. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the vehicle.

Reaching the marked destination is the purpose of the drive, so pay attention to the route as well as the space around your car. Adjust your steering as you approach turns and obstacles to bring the vehicle to its target safely.

pages.title: FZ Water Crisis
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description:
FZ Water Crisis is a water-routing puzzle in which trees need a supply of water. Work out a path that carries the water to them, using the mouse to interact with the puzzle. The arrangement of each level determines where the flow needs to go.

Look at the water source and the tree's position before choosing the route. Your task is to connect those two parts of the scene so the water reaches the place that needs it.

pages.title: Halloween Catcher
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Halloween Catcher turns a Halloween candy haul into a race against the clock. Move to catch sweets and collect as many as possible before the allotted time runs out. You can use the arrow keys or the mouse to play.

Watch where the candy is heading and reposition to meet it. Each opportunity adds to the amount you can gather during the round, making quick movement and attention to the remaining time the main parts of the challenge.

pages.title: Biggy Race
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description:
Take a monster car over rough roads in Biggy Race. Drive across the uneven terrain while collecting money and stars along the route. The road itself is part of the challenge, requiring you to keep the vehicle moving through its changing slopes.

Use the arrow keys or the touch controls to drive. Money you gather can go toward buying other cars, giving your collection runs a longer-term purpose. Balance making progress along the road with reaching the pickups you want to bring home.

pages.title: Bouncing Strawberry
pages.creator: TırtılMedya
pages.description:
Bouncing Strawberry puts a strawberry among dangerous swords and asks you to keep it unharmed. Guide its bounces through the hazards, judging the space around each blade before moving onward. Contact with the swords is the danger to avoid.

The strawberry's position relative to the blades is what matters throughout the challenge. Watch the available opening and time the next bounce to carry it through without a hit.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Fancy Dress
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Baby Hazel Fancy Dress follows Hazel's preparations for a school costume competition with a birds-and-animals theme. She wants to appear as a peacock, and you help turn that choice into a finished outfit. Begin by joining Hazel and her mother to buy the materials needed for the costume.

Next, help them make the clothing and matching accessories before dressing Hazel for the event. The activities follow the costume from shopping through tailoring to the final look, rather than stopping at outfit selection. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel, her mother and the items in each scene. The school event also includes a play performed by the children.

pages.title: Real Gangster City Crime Vegas 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Real Gangster City Crime Vegas 3D is a city action game about stealing vehicles, driving around and fighting rival gangsters. Explore its Vegas setting using vehicles such as cars and motorbikes, or take to the streets on foot with a weapon. Moving between driving and combat lets you approach the city in different ways.

WASD or the arrow keys control movement and driving. Use the left mouse button to strike or shoot, hold Shift to run, and press L to lock or release the cursor. Watch your surroundings as you explore, particularly when leaving a vehicle and returning to a fight.

pages.title: Miner Dash
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
Miner Dash gives you 30 in-game days to dig your way to the Earth's core. Move underground, gather useful materials and use your finds to craft items that help the expedition continue. The goal is to reach the core within that limited span and finish with a high score.

New recipes become available as you progress, expanding what you can make from the elements you collect. Digging and crafting form a repeating cycle: explore deeper, bring in resources and put them to use before continuing downward. Use the arrow keys or the on-screen tap controls to move through the mine.

pages.title: Real Garbage Truck
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Drive a city collection vehicle in Real Garbage Truck and bring it to the marked rubbish pickup locations. Your task involves approaching the bins and stopping the truck beside them, putting both driving and parking into the collection routine.

Use WASD to move the vehicle. Keep track of the marked places as you travel, then line up your approach so you can stop near the bins. The focus is on positioning the truck for its work around the city.

pages.title: Zombify Me
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Zombify Me begins with a familiar city transformed into a place inhabited by ghosts and zombies. Your task is to run away from the danger and get as far as you can. Use WASD to move through this altered setting.

Keep moving as you face the creatures around you, with distance as the focus of the escape. The horror premise becomes a survival run through a city that has changed overnight.

pages.title: PUBG Craft BATTLEGROUNDS
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description:
PUBG Craft BATTLEGROUNDS is a shooting game where you arm your character and fight opponents. Look for weapons, collect equipment and use the inventory to manage what you carry. Doors and weapon pickups are interactive parts of the environment, making movement and gathering supplies part of the action alongside shooting.

Move with WASD and fire with the mouse. Press F to pick up a weapon or open a door, and use E for the inventory. C lets your character crouch, Space jumps, M opens the map and V changes the camera. Use those movement and view options as you search the area and engage enemies.

pages.title: Guess The Soccer Star
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Guess The Soccer Star tests how well you recognize football players. Identify the star shown in each puzzle and enter their surname to solve it. A correct answer earns coins that you can use when another player's name proves harder to recall.

The helper tools include revealing a letter and removing a letter from the choices. Decide when a hint would be useful, then use the information it provides to finish the name. Each puzzle focuses on recognition and surname knowledge, letting you move from familiar faces to players you may know less well.

pages.title: Duck Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Duck Memory Challenge asks you to find every pair of matching pictures. Choose a level mode and select the images with the mouse or by tapping. Remember which pictures you have seen and where they appeared so you can bring matching ones together.

The objective is to account for all the pairs in the chosen game. Pay attention to each selection, including pictures that do not match yet, because their positions can help with a later pair.

pages.title: Red Outpost
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Red Outpost puts you in charge of a new settlement on Mars. Recruit astronauts from Earth and develop the activities that keep the colony growing. Your workers can raise crops in the habitat, produce power from solar energy and mine the planet's rocks.

As the outpost develops, discover technologies and purchase upgrades to extend what it can do. The management loop connects your workforce with the resources each activity produces, giving you several areas to improve rather than a single production task. Use the interactive tutorial to learn the systems, then decide how to expand the settlement and put its next improvements to work.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Raccoon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Bubble Shooter Raccoon combines colored-bubble shooting with a rescue objective. Aim and fire bubbles to make groups of three matching colors, clearing the way to the trapped baby animals. Saving all the cubs is the goal of a level, so choose shots that help reach them.

Use the mouse to play and work through the sequence of puzzles. Power-ups provide additional help, including a ball that can match any color and an extended aiming line. Watch the babies still waiting to be rescued as you decide which part of the bubble formation to tackle next.

pages.title: Dude Basket
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Dude Basket is a basketball shooting game with a sequence of target-based levels. Line up your shots and send the ball through the hoop to complete the current challenge. Successful shooting is how you advance to the next level.

Pay attention to the position of the basket when setting up an attempt. Each level gives you another arrangement to judge, so adjust your aim to the target in front of you rather than repeating the same shot throughout the game.

pages.title: Monkey Escape
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description:
Monkey Escape is a climbing game where clicks or taps send a monkey jumping between the two sides of the play area. Keep gaining height while avoiding the circular hazards in your path. Waiting too long lets the monkey slide downward toward the spikes below.

Watch the next stretch before making the jump across. You need enough momentum to continue climbing, but each leap also has to avoid the obstacles between the sides. The height you reach measures how far you have carried the monkey before the escape ends.

pages.title: Ninja Run Online
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description:
Ninja Run Online sends a ninja along a dangerous route filled with jumps, thorns and bombs. Try to cover as much distance as possible while gathering coins, gold and jewels. The pickups give you something to pursue, but the hazards make every part of the route a movement challenge.

Look ahead before committing to a jump, especially when treasure is near an obstacle. Keeping the run going means judging those dangers while continuing toward the next stretch of the course.

pages.title: Worms Combat Coop
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Worms Combat Coop is an action game about fighting worm-like enemies with a choice of weapons. Move through generated levels, deal with attackers and pick up equipment as you continue. Enemies include creatures that attack up close as well as those that use projectiles.

Play on your own or share the same keyboard with a friend in local cooperative play. The level generator changes the spaces you fight through, while weapon pickups give you different ways to respond to the creatures around you. Keep track of your health and work together when playing as a pair to continue through the encounters.

pages.title: Rider 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Rider 2 puts you on a motorcycle in an endless stunt-riding challenge. Jump, perform flips and collect coins while trying to improve your score. The run keeps giving you opportunities to attempt another stunt and push your performance further.

Use the mouse or touch controls to play. Coins let you buy other motorcycles, giving you something to work toward between attempts. Focus on controlling the bike through its jumps as you build a run with more flips and a score worth beating.

pages.title: Fishing Frenzy
pages.creator: Gaming Club
pages.description:
Fishing Frenzy is an arcade fishing game where catches build your score and clock pickups keep the round going. Move the boat into position, lower the hook toward the fish and bring in your catch. You can also use bombs against the creatures below.

Use Left and Right, or A and D, to move the boat. Down or S lowers the line, while Space drops a bomb. Collect the floating clock bubbles when you can: they add time, allowing you to keep fishing and chase a larger score before the timer expires.

pages.title: Surf Riders
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description:
Surf Riders puts you in charge of lining up waves so a surfer can keep riding. Align the approaching sections of water to prevent the character from falling off the board. The challenge is to maintain a continuous ride as the waves keep coming.

Staying upright for longer lets you unlock more characters. Watch the next wave section while the surfer crosses the current one, and prepare its alignment in time to keep the run going.

pages.title: Judy Super Hero
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Judy Super Hero is a dress-up game about helping Judy Hopps choose a superhero look for an evening with friends. Browse the clothing options and put together an outfit that suits her adventurous plans. Use the mouse to select the items you want her to wear.

The focus is on styling Judy for the occasion. Compare the available dresses and costume choices, then combine them into the look you want her friends to see.

pages.title: Princess Events Agenda
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Events Agenda follows a princess with several occasions to prepare for. Help her get ready by choosing her hairstyle, working on her makeup and finding an outfit for the event ahead. Each part of the makeover contributes to the completed look.

Use the agenda as the reason to try different styles across her schedule. Match the hair, cosmetics and clothing to the occasion you are preparing for, then see how the choices work together on the princess.

pages.title: TanksIO.online
pages.creator: WI Games
pages.description:
TanksIO.online is a team tank-combat game where both sides compete to reach 25 eliminations first. Fight alongside your teammates in the arena and look for power-ups that appear around the map. Every destroyed opponent brings your team closer to the winning total.

Supporting the other tanks matters because your own destruction also gives the opposing team progress. Cover teammates, collect useful power-ups and consider the risk before charging into another fight. The match is decided by the team score, making staying alive and helping an ally relevant to the same objective as landing your own attacks.

pages.title: Wheely 7
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Wheely 7 turns Wheely into a detective investigating a robbery. Search the scenes for hidden clues and help him follow the mystery toward the thieves. Use the mouse to click Wheely and the objects around him.

The investigation unfolds through interactive puzzles. Look over each scene for something you can use or change, then see how it affects Wheely's route or the search for evidence. Progress comes from working out the scene's interactions while following the case onward.

pages.title: Swap tycoon
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description:
Swap tycoon is a number puzzle where you swap or slide tiles to make a line containing at least three identical numbers. The matching tiles merge, producing a block with a higher number. Each combination changes the arrangement you have to work with next.

Look for a move that brings equal values into one line, then consider what the resulting merge leaves behind. Both swapping and sliding help you organize the board as you build up larger numbers through repeated matches.

pages.title: Annas Birthday in Hawaii
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description:
Annas Birthday in Hawaii follows a plan to rescue Anna's birthday from cold, rainy weather. Elsa, Kristoff and Moana have arranged a surprise celebration in Hawaii, and you help prepare it at Moana's home. Start by decorating the party venue for the occasion.

Once the setting is ready, choose outfits for the hosts and then dress Anna herself. The game brings party decoration and character styling into the same birthday preparations, letting you shape both the room and the guests' appearance before the celebration begins.

pages.title: Pregnant Ice Queen Bath Care
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Pregnant Ice Queen Bath Care follows the Ice Queen through a bath and makeover before she becomes a mother. Add flowers and scented oils to the tub, then use the game's spa masks as part of her pampering routine. Tap the items to carry out each activity.

After the bath, move on to makeup and clothing. Try different combinations to create a finished look for the character. The sequence takes you from preparing the bath through the cosmetic and dress-up choices at the end.

pages.title: Mystic Sea Treasures
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Mystic Sea Treasures is an underwater matching puzzle. Swap neighboring tiles to line up three of the same symbol and work through the treasure-themed playing field. Use the left mouse button to select your moves.

The game also includes magical effects that you can collect and use on the board. Look for matching symbols within reach of a swap, then consider how an available effect could help with the tiles around them. Combining ordinary matches with those effects is part of the search for the sea's treasure.

pages.title: College Fashion Show
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description:
College Fashion Show puts Ariel, Cinderella and Aurora on a runway with outfits chosen for college life. Help the three participants put their looks together before presenting them at the show. The styling challenge centers on clothing they can showcase as fashionable student outfits.

Anna, Elsa, Jasmine and Merida serve as the judges and score what their friends wear. Prepare each participant's look and see how the judging panel responds. The show connects your outfit choices with the characters' runway appearance and the scores that follow.

pages.title: Gun Builder
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
Gun Builder lets you assemble virtual firearms and then try them at a target range. Work from a prepared weapon design or choose parts for a custom creation. Arrange the components in the building stage before moving to the shooting test.

Target practice gives the finished weapon something to do after assembly. Aim at the targets and fire to test your creation, then return to building when you want to try another arrangement. The game links choosing and fitting virtual parts with a separate shooting activity.

pages.title: Bubble Game 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Bubble Game 3 is a bubble shooter about clearing colored groups and building a score. Aim with the mouse and click to fire. Connect at least three bubbles of the same color to pop them; bubbles cut off from the top of the formation also fall away.

Shots that fail to make a match reduce the remaining allowance before new rows are added. Look for groups you can reach and connections that support other bubbles, since removing a useful cluster can clear more than the matching colors alone. Keep opening space as you try to remove as many bubbles as possible.

pages.title: Elsa Family Christmas
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Elsa Family Christmas follows Elsa and Jack as they prepare to celebrate with their twins. Help tidy the room before Christmas Eve by collecting dirty clothes and diapers, then put the children's toys back in their places. Tap the items to take part in the preparations.

Once the room is clean, decorate it for the family's first Christmas with the babies. Finish the festive scene with the gingerbread plate ready for Santa's visit. The activities move from household cleanup to decorating, bringing the family home into shape for the celebration.

pages.title: Soccer Mover 2015
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description:
Soccer Mover 2015 is a physics puzzle about getting a football into the goal. Click removable objects to change the ball's route, letting gravity and the remaining platforms guide its movement. The order in which you clear obstacles can determine whether the ball reaches the net or leaves the play area.

Levels introduce additional objects such as fans, explosives and teleporters that affect the route. Work out how the ball will travel before removing a support, and try to collect stars along the way. Each puzzle ends when the required goals have been reached.
